data: In the top plot, is the blue line  consistently above the red line '?

The question asks whether the blue line is consistently above the red line in the top plot. From the caption, we can see that the blue line represents "Time decisions made," and the red line represents "Total meeting time." 

Looking at the top plot, the blue line starts below the red line but eventually crosses over it and remains above the red line for most of the range. However, there is a point where the blue line dips below the red line, indicating that the total meeting time exceeds the time when decisions are made. This happens around the 80th meeting mark.

Therefore, the blue line is not consistently above the red line throughout the entire range. It is only consistently above the red line up until approximately the 80th meeting mark.
